instruction: Make Arial the standard font for headings in every new Writer file.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring LibreOffice Writer's default font for headings to Arial. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu file for the Heading property in the DefaultFont configuration section. This is similar to the original task but targets a different font property (Heading instead of Standard) and a different font (Arial instead of Times New Roman).
metadata.verification: The metric function check_writer_default_font__fa1d18205feb8f13dd50f8fb2fafcd8d reads the LibreOffice configuration XML file and extracts the font name for the Heading property. It uses the same XML parsing approach as the original find_default_font function but allows flexibility to check different properties.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets the LibreOffice configuration file (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu) that stores default font settings
Metric function uses the correct XML path (/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont) to locate the default font configuration section
Correctly checks the 'Heading' property specifically, which matches the instruction requirement for 'headings in all new Writer documents'
Proper parameter handling: metric function correctly receives rules dictionary directly as 'expected' parameter (lines 7, 26-28) without incorrectly accessing 'expected.get("rules")'
Expected value 'Arial' matches the instruction requirement exactly
Appropriate exact string comparison for font name verification
Adequate edge case handling: returns 0 if file cannot be fetched or if XML parsing fails
No postconfig needed since configuration file is persistent and applies to future documents automatically
